import unicodedata
def slugify(text: str, sep: str = "-") -> str:
    import re
    _NON_WORD = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    text = text.lower()
    text = _NON_WORD.sub(sep, text)
    return text.strip(sep)

print(slugify("Crème Brûlée"))
print(slugify("Ñandú"))

from slugify import slugify
print("Crème Brûlée:", repr(slugify("Crème Brûlée")))
print("Ñandú:", repr(slugify("Ñandú")))
print("Hello World:", repr(slugify("Hello World")))
print("a -- b!!c:", repr(slugify("a -- b!!c")))
print("Hello World (sep=_):", repr(slugify("Hello World", sep="_")))
